note:
Venues that have CLOSED but which current 'best of' lists still recommend. Published guides are slow to update and some never do, so a closed venue keeps accruing source counts and looks better-supported the longer it has been shut. scripts/build-evidence.mjs drops anything listed here, and the write scripts refuse to add a row for one.

Every entry needs a date and at least one source. If a venue reopens, delete its entry rather than editing it to 'open'.

locanda locatelli.name: Locanda Locatelli
locanda locatelli.detail: Closed January 2025 after 23 years and a 20-year Michelin star.

normans cafe.name: Norman's Cafe
normans cafe.detail: 167 Junction Road, Archway N19 5PZ. Last day of trading Sunday 8 June 2025 after five years; announced on its own Instagram. The Shoreditch residency at Seed Library was a 2022 pop-up and is also finished. A co-founder opens Marrion's in Hackney in September 2026, explicitly with no fry-ups, so the caff format is not carrying over.
normans cafe.note: BBC Good Food's 'Best brunch in London, 2025' still names its chip butty, and that page published over a month AFTER the closure. A useful reminder that a recent date on a listicle is not evidence a venue is open.

yorica.name: Yorica
yorica.detail: 130 Wardour Street, Soho. London's first allergen-free parlour - free from dairy, nuts, gluten, eggs and wheat, on a seaweed, vanilla and rice base. Closure date not established.

black milq.name: Black Milq
black milq.detail: Containerville, 35 Corbridge Crescent E2. 100% vegan on in-house cashew and coconut milk - black sesame, miso caramel, five-spice golden milk. Great Taste Award 2018, a Time Out best-of in 2019, closed by June 2022. Time Out now marks it (CLOSED).

montys deli.name: Monty's Deli
montys deli.detail: Hoxton site closed July 2019 and the business wound down after the pandemic; montys-deli.com now redirects to an unrelated cafe. Still named as a salt beef destination in older guides.

doms subs.name: Dom's Subs
doms subs.detail: City (7 Cullum St) closed March 2026; Ludgate Circus closed 3 April 2026; the Hackney Road flagship is reported closed. Only a residency at Rasputin's, 171 Mare Street, is still cited. Its OWN SITE still lists all three dead addresses - a venue's own website is not proof it is trading.

sons and daughters borough.name: Sons + Daughters (Borough Market branch)
sons and daughters borough.detail: The Borough Market unit is now Camille. The King's Cross site at Coal Drops Yard is still open - this entry retires the BRANCH, not the business.

hacha.name: Hacha
hacha.detail: 378 Kingsland Rd E8. Closed 25 April 2026 after seven years, per its own site. Also a category error in most listings: it was an AGAVERIA - an agave-spirits cocktail bar - not a Mexican restaurant; the tacos came from a partner kitchen. Survives only as a travelling residency.

sorabol.name: Sorabol
sorabol.detail: 180 High Street, New Malden KT3 4ES. Permanently closed - was Korean royal/traditional cuisine. Still appears on several live London Korean guides.

cornerstone.name: Cornerstone
cornerstone.detail: 3 Prince Edward Road, Hackney Wick E9 5NP. Tom Brown announced closure June 2024 after six years, citing the cost of running a tasting-menu restaurant. Held a Michelin star and was rated London's number one seafood restaurant by Harden's. Its old domain has lapsed and now serves casino spam - do not link it.

nightjar carnaby.name: Nightjar (Carnaby)
nightjar carnaby.detail: Kingly Court, 49-51 Carnaby Street W1F 9PY. Final service Saturday 27 September 2025. The Shoreditch site at 129 City Road still trades.

bar termini centrale.name: Bar Termini Centrale
bar termini centrale.detail: 31 Duke Street, Marylebone. Removed from the Bar Termini website August 2021. The Old Compton Street original still trades.

kwant heddon street.name: Kwant (original, Heddon Street)
kwant heddon street.detail: 110 Heddon Street, the basement under Momo - closed 2021 when Momo went into liquidation. Erik Lorincz reopened as Kwant Mayfair at 52 Stratton Street W1J 8LN in summer 2023. Guides still describe it as a basement under Shepherd Market, which was never right.

balady.name: Balady
balady.detail: 750-756 Finchley Road, Temple Fortune NW11 7TH. Israeli kosher, NOT Palestinian and not on Edgware Road as often listed. Uber Eats storefront closed July 2025 and balady.co.uk serves a Coming Soon placeholder. Treat as closed/uncertain pending a phone check.

meza mitcham road.name: Meza (Mitcham Road)
meza mitcham road.detail: 70 Mitcham Road SW17 9NA has closed. The Trinity Road site (SW17 7RE) still trades. Both addresses still circulate on aggregators.

ruby violet.name: Ruby Violet
ruby violet.detail: Listings conflict between Kentish Town (118 Fortess Rd NW5 2HL) and King's Cross (Midland Goods Shed N1C 4BZ), and the King's Cross reference is from 2018. Own site fails with a TLS error. Do NOT publish as open without a direct check.

prime gelato.name: Prime Gelato
prime gelato.detail: 216 Shaftesbury Ave WC2H 8EB. Best-documented standing vegan commitment in London (six vegan gelati at all times, all sorbets vegan) but the site would not resolve and the detail traces to a 2021 guide. Verify before publishing.

bodega ritas.name: Bodega Rita's
bodega ritas.detail: 91 Cowcross St EC1M 6BH. Named by two current guides but a directory now marks it closed. Verify before publishing.

melt room.name: Melt Room
melt room.detail: Toastie specialist; domain dead and status unverifiable. Deliberately left out of the sandwich guide for that reason.

sonora taqueria postcode.name: Sonora Taqueria (postcode conflict)
sonora taqueria postcode.detail: 208 Stoke Newington High Street. Sources split between N16 7HU and N16 8BP. Do not print a postcode until one is confirmed.

hijackedDomains.note: Lapsed venue domains now serving gambling/casino content. Never link these. A hijacked domain is not proof the business has closed.
